question: Among all carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one double bond, compute the average number of oxygen atoms per molecule. Only include molecules that have at least one atom whose ID ends with the digit '4'.

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS avg_oxygen_per_molecule
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id,
        COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS oxygen_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
      AND a.XCL_003 = 'o'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM bond b
          WHERE b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
            AND b.XCL_006 = '='
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM atom a2
          WHERE a2.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
            AND a2.XCL_001 LIKE '%4'
      )
    GROUP BY m.XCL_010
) AS subquery

SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS avg_oxygen_per_molecule
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id,
        COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS oxygen_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
      AND a.XCL_003 = 'o'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM bond b
          WHERE b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
            AND b.XCL_006 = '='
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM atom a2
          WHERE a2.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
            AND a2.XCL_001 LIKE '%4'
      )
    GROUP BY m.XCL_010
) AS subquery
